risk_if_not_implemented: Without Website Change Detection, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: File Activity Monitoring (FAM)
compensating_control_1.description: Automated mechanisms exist to monitor sensitive and/or regulated data in Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) and data repositories.
compensating_control_1.justification: File Activity Monitoring (FAM) (MON-28) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Website Change Detection (WEB-12) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
